page0.text:
...I hear a sound.
Slight tremors shake the cave.
I can only barely hear the light and sound from afar, but the cave is creaking and shaking.

page1.text:
Is that thunder in the distance?
I wonder about it absently, but I can't remember a time I ever heard distant thunder.

page2.text:
...The dagger in my hand began to crumble as soon as Saber disappeared back into the shadows.
It's probably the cost of killing a powerful familiar like a Servant.
The Azoth Blade that Tohsaka put her life savings into has crumbled to dust.

page3.text:
...
I tightly fasten the bindings on my left arm.
I've used up most of my magical energy.
There's some left in Archer's arm, and some left in me.
I think I can manage with that combined power, but I'm limited to one last Projection. I won't be able to control Archer's arm anymore, no matter what I do afterwards.

page4.text:
"Ri...der..."
Oh, right. I wonder what happened to her.
I stand up.

page5.text:
My body feels hard.
It feels like my joints have turned into steel.
I bet bullets would bounce off me now.

page6.text:
"Rider, are you all right?"
I can't walk very well.
I walk.

page7.text:
I'm bleeding.
I pretend not to see it.
The pain feels like someone drove iron stakes into my legs, but luckily, I can grit my teeth and walk through it.

page8.text:
...Something is making a sound, far away.
It sounds like something I heard a long time ago, when I was a kid.
The fact I can remember things I heard that long ago must mean I'm still a kid at heart.
I had a lot of interests when I was a kid.

page9.text:
"Rider."
I walk up to the wall she got smashed into.
Rider's still alive.
But she's beat up all over, and most of her magical energy is spent.
She probably can't move right away.
...She should take a break.

page10.text:
"I'm going on ahead. Catch up later once you can run."
I mutter at the fallen Rider, and turn to go deeper into the cave.

page11.text:
"Ngh...urgh. You're more of a slave driver than I expected."
Looks like she's conscious.
Rider can't stand up right away, and she looks up like something's very bright.

page12.text:
"Sorry. I know I'm leaning a lot on you. Take some time to recover and then catch up."
"...Yes. I'll be right there. Don't worry."

page13.text:
Rider won't push herself too hard.
She knows that she should take time to properly recover instead of forcing herself to get up.
She isn't reckless like me. It's so reassuring.

page14.text:
...The tremors are happening more often.
I can't waste time here.
I go after Tohsaka, though I can't move my body very well.

page15.text:
"Ngh... Hah, haah."
I'm getting breathless.
I use the wall to support myself as I move forward.
My pace isn't bad.
My body just feels stiff, but it shouldn't get in the way once I get used to it.

page16.text:
"Burgh...ngh, hah, gugh, guh."
Something comes out of my mouth.
I pretend not to notice it and wipe my lips.

page17.text:
"Zzrgh, agh..."
My thigh muscles go snap and feel numb. I nearly trip over.
I'm pretty sure I heard a snap.
My clothes are torn from the inside, and I can see gaping wounds.
I do my best not to look at them and keep walking.

page18.text:
I'm close.
A lukewarm wind brushes against my body.
"...Here goes."
I clap my cheeks and start running.

page19.text:
I leave the darkness.
A wasteland I've seen before spreads out before me, filling my vision.
No, not quite.
I haven't seen this sight before.
That didn't exist in the wasteland I saw in Illya's record.

page20.text:
"That's..."
The root cause of this absurd war.
The thing that took Sakura from me.

page21.text:
"It's almost incarnated..."
I'm assailed by a sense of menace and revulsion.
Its excessively vital breathing declares that it's on the cusp of its birth.

page22.text:
Flashes of light and tremors.
The light lashes out from the top of the cliff, haphazardly blasting the cavern.
...I don't know what's happening up there, but given how flashy it is, it can only be Tohsaka.

page23.text:
Which means...I see.
"You're panicking."
I look around.
The eyeless, twisted fetus is looking at me.

page24.text:
...No doubt about it.
It must not like Tohsaka's rampage very much, because it really wants to come out.
But its body isn't ready yet.
Its placenta is inside that dark pillar.
It can't come out unless its body is fully formed.

page25.text:
That's why it's worried that Tohsaka will destroy its placenta, and it's rushing to finish its body.
It wants to be born in this world as a Servant with a flesh-and-blood body.

page26.text:
"...Not on my watch."
I run.
I see a desperate clash of light and darkness.

page27.text:
"Sakura...?"
Once I get close enough to make out Sakura and Tohsaka fighting...
Time stops in the cavern.
An enormous source of light blinds me enough to feel that way, and...

page28.text:
"Nee-san."
I hear a child-like wail, and the world begins to shake violently.

page29.text:
The light didn't destroy the chamber walls.
This is destruction on a more fundamental level. It's the frenzied squirming of that giant shadow attempting to come out.

page30.text:
"That was..."
A horrible chill runs down my spine.
I have an ominous feeling.
Sakura's wailing voice prophesies the worst thing I could see.

page31.text:
"Tohsaka...Tohsaka, Tohsaka!"
I run.
Breathing wildly, I scramble up the cliff using —-afflicted limbs.

page32.text:
The tremors won't stop.
Boom.
Somewhere in the wasteland, I hear a large boulder fall.

page33.text:
"Hah... Haah, haah, haah, hah...!"
I don't care what's going on behind me.
Covered in dirt, I single-mindedly climb the cliff,
and a scene that I was too late to stop is burned into my eyes.

page34.text:
"......Tohsaka."
...The ground is shaking.
Tohsaka's sprawled face down, and I can't see her face.
She resembles a large flower fallen from its stem.
